## Ruled-out approaches
- Treating every `httpx.HTTPStatusError` as retryable; 4xx errors such as 422 should fail immediately. Retry only transport failures and retryable server responses.
- Swallowing the final transport exception or replacing it with a generic error; re-raise the last exception after attempts are exhausted.
- Adding long test delays; patch `time.sleep` in retry tests while preserving bounded production backoff.
- Editing `config/ledgerly.toml` before posting its diff in `#billing-config` for `@maya`.
- Editing `ledgerly/customer_export/` before posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving `@mina`’s approval.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; this concealed stuck jobs for hours.
- Writing staging exports to the frozen `ledgerly-exports-stg` bucket; staging must use `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`.
